_meta.title: Empty Latent Video
_meta.notes: 832x480 is Wan2.2 native 16:9 training resolution. Do NOT use 1920x1080 here — upscale in ffmpeg assembly instead.

_meta.title: Wan Video Sampler
_meta.notes: Quality settings tuned for Apple Silicon MPS. cfg=6.5 prevents color banding above 7.5. euler+linear is temporally stable on MPS fp16. motion_bucket_id=100 gives deliberate cinematic motion without erratic movement. augmentation_level=0.0 prevents compounding grain artifacts.

_meta.title: VAE Decode Tiled
_meta.notes: VAEDecodeTiled_Video is MANDATORY on MPS. Standard VAEDecode OOMs on 81 frames at 832x480. tile_size=256 + overlap=64 prevents tile seam artifacts. temporal_size=64 + temporal_overlap=8 prevents frame-boundary flickering.
